patch_description: The parent uses three movement experts, per-step retention of .985/.86, a three-step planner, and collision weight 100. This revision forecasts each expert separately, preserving uncertainty about the shared movement law. Planning adds a .30 disagreement penalty only near visible threats and among plausible experts. Learning uses informative-observation retention of .99/.84, preserving evidence during observation gaps while retaining a responsive expert. Progress-aware waiting costs and deadline-dependent risk pricing target remaining timeouts. Anonymous association, blocked-attempt stays, independent mapping, and separate learning/prediction-use interventions remain supported. These are proposed improvements; no new evaluation results are claimed.
